description: Gross-to-net salary in the Netherlands for 2026: income tax with the general and labour tax credits, optional 8% holiday allowance on top, the 30% ruling (with its salary norm and cap) and a pension contribution. Returns net per month and per year and the effective tax rate. Single employee below state pension age.

gross_annual.description: Gross annual salary in euros, without holiday allowance (e.g. 60000)

holiday_allowance_on_top.description: Add the 8% holiday allowance (vakantiegeld) on top of the gross salary. Default false.

pension_percent.description: Employee pension contribution as % of salary, 0-30. Default 0.

thirty_percent_ruling.description: The employee has the 30% ruling. Default false.

name: net_salary_netherlands
title: Dutch net salary (take-home pay)
